name: margin
description: Cost and value per outcome for your AI agents: connect them to Margin, see spend per job, find the steps worth a face-off, and get Margin's verdict on a model or eval change before you make it. Anything that spends needs an agent key with a spend limit that a person creates.

api_key.title: Margin ingest key
api_key.description: Your project's ingest key (mgk_…), from the Margin console or trymargin.io/start. Stored in your system's secure credential store, never in a settings file.

margin_url.title: Margin URL
margin_url.description: Where Margin runs. Leave the default unless you were given another.
